environment.guest_settings: scrub inherited PS2_/GT4_PERF_ options; set GT4_PERF=1 PS2_SCALE=1 PS2_GS=gpu
environment.vulkan: preserve and record VK_ overrides in session result; other driver/overlay state not controlled
environment.gs_submission: GT4_GS_SYNC=0 default (asynchronous); GT4_GS_SYNC=1 restores the fully synchronous path (launcher records the value in the session result)
environment.pacing: GT4_PACING unset or paced (default): paced clock. GT4_PACING=audio: blocking WinMM clock as in slice152. GT4_PRESENT_MODE unset or fifo (default); mailbox and immediate are experiments and fail at swapchain creation when the surface lacks them. The launcher refuses other values and records both names in result.json (pacing_environment).

toolchain.build: CMake/Ninja VS2022 x64 ABI Windows SDK10.0.26100.0

classification: The slice202/203 pcsx2 game recipe (slice191 runtime capsule, slice200 port and memcard capsule, gt4-gs 1.0.1 package) plus the TASK-017 license guard capsule (dispatch.cpp guard, halt dump and FSV read trace off by default).
preserved_inputs: Same runtime capsule, port, memcard capsule, shaders, EE library (ps2game.lib not rebuilt), VU1 and VU0 tables and gt4-gs 1.0.1 package as slice203; new: the license guard capsule.
limits: Unsynchronized readbacks answer from the PCSX2 GS local memory copy: GPU-drawn pixels are stale (zeros in the gs_live_check sprite test), so the night-race lens flare may change; accurate is the default.
Deferred swap chain acquire and detached input queues are checked only with hidden windows; the owner checks the visible window (fullscreen, Alt+Tab, minimize).
Interlaced races (480i held) and the 1080i/PAL modes are not checked; only the 480i menus capture (slice191 stream) was replayed headless.
Save states are refused in pcsx2 mode.
The owner night-race numbers (59.97 FPS, 53 late frames) were measured on slice198 with gt4-gs 0.3.2; slice199 on gt4-gs 0.4.0 needs the owner's night race and F8 A/B (GT4_MTVU_PRIV_ASYNC 1 vs 0).
GT4_MTVU_PRIV_ASYNC is proven equivalent (identical stream bytes, identical frames) on the recorded headless schedules only; race scenes are checked by the owner F8 A/B.
Crash-safe card: the kill test kills a copy writer (TerminateProcess), not an OS power cut; FlushFileBuffers/_commit is trusted, not measured on a power cut.
Installed-folder run (<exe>\shaders, <exe>\gs) is smoked from private/slice200-dist only; the owner installs nothing.
Headless runs do not reach a save: the menus schedule leaves the card byte-identical to the seed; the exit flush is checked by the build and the fixture, not by a saved headless card.

The cursor auto-hide, the "Compiling shaders" notice and the overlay are checked with a short visible fixture window and hidden-window replays only; the owner checks them in the game (fullscreen and windowed).
GPU usage comes from the Windows "GPU Engine" performance counters (PDH) of the two processes; other GPU vendors and drivers are not checked.

gt4-gs 1.0.1 (Documents\PCSX2 fix): the offline replay (--replay-gscap) with a DataRoot config stops after VM initialization (exit -16843010, same stop as the 1.0.0 logs); the folder check is therefore a startup-only check.

License guard: a demo that fails the game CRC and is not the single-Recorder layout gets record count 0xFFFFFFFF (no demo inputs); its demo or background replay does not play. Demos that decrypt sane (CRC failing) still load their header region with wrong bytes (FPU not bit-exact; TASK-017 root cause not fixed).

gs_stream.consumer: gt4-gs.exe (PCSX2 v2.8.2 GS, GPL-3.0+, fork moesuito/gt4recomp-gs) in a separate process; the game checks its SHA-256 (GT4_GS_PROCESS_SHA256) and passes the generated gt4-gs.ini (GT4_GS_CONFIG)
gs_stream.protocol: native/gs_stream/gs_stream_protocol.h version 1.2 (CONTROL cursor, OSD_STATS, READY OSD flag; vendored in the fork by hash)

gs_package.source: the published stable release gt4gs-v1.0.1 (fork branch gt4gs/main, merged from gt4gs/datadir), built on the owner PC with gt4gs/release-local.ps1 -Release (GT4GS_ONLY=ON, deps of private/slice193-gt4gs-deps, check-nojit passed); the zip was downloaded back, checked against SHA256SUMS and extracted: the pinned package is the published one
gs_package.no_jit: GT4GS_ONLY build: no recompilers, no x86 emitter, no GS software JIT, no executable memory; Arbitrary Code Guard on at start (log: "GT4GS no-JIT: Arbitrary Code Guard on ... error 1655"); audit at the end of the stream and at exit (log: "0 executable non-image regions")
